name: Girardot Groupe
overview: Girardot Groupe is a French family-owned company operating in tourism and mobility since 1920. Based in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, it provides travel agency services, custom trip organization, business travel management, and diverse transportation solutions including regular daily transit, group trips, and tourist coaches.

campaigns.description: Highlighting over a century of local transport mastery and family heritage, this campaign grounds Girardot Groupe in the rich textures and winding scenic landscapes of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté to position the brand as the undisputed expert in seamless regional mobility.
Experience the quiet elegance of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté as autumn turns to winter. Book tailored group excursions and regional transit designed to bring family, friends, and communities together.
Celebrate over a century of shared moments, scenic escapes, and human connection. This campaign highlights our commitment to bringing families, friends, and local communities closer on every trip.

creatives.title: Feel the Joy of the Road
